lines.t: Intro — Female, soft]
In knowing You…
I have all things…
I chased the gold, I chased the noise
Looking for a lasting joy
But every road that led away
Left my heart with less to say
Then in the quiet, You called my name
And nothing in me stayed the same
I found a treasure time can’t steal
A love more real than what I feel
You are the answer, You are the way
More than tomorrow, more than today
In knowing You, I have all things
More than the world could ever bring
You are my hope, my song, my King
In knowing You, I have all things
When storms arise and shadows fall
Your faithful love is over all
I don’t need riches, I don’t need fame
I have enough when I know Your name
The earth may shake beneath my feet
Still Your mercy carries me
What could compare, what could replace
The peace I find within Your grace?
You are my shelter, You are my home
I’m never empty, never alone
The deepest need inside my soul
Is met in You; You make me whole
You are the answer, You are the way
More than tomorrow, more than today
In knowing You, I have all things
More than the world could ever bring
You are my hope, my song, my King
In knowing You, I have all things
When storms arise and shadows fall
Your faithful love is over all
I don’t need riches, I don’t need fame
I have enough when I know Your name
You are the treasure
You are the prize
The light of Heaven
Before my eyes
Nothing can take
What You have given me
YahuShua, forever
You are enough for me
You are the treasure
You are the prize
YahuShua, forever
Be lifted high
In knowing You, I have all things
More than the world could ever bring
You are my hope, my song, my King
In knowing You, I have all things
I have a Savior, I have a song
I have Your strength to carry on
No matter where this life may lead
In knowing You, You’re all I need
In knowing You…
I have all things…
YahuShua, You are
All I need
